'''Bernardo Uribe Jongbloed''' (born 1975) is a Colombian mathematician. Uribe's research deals with [[algebraic geometry]] and [[algebraic topology|topology]] with [[string theory]] applications.

==Biography==
Uribe graduated from secondary school in [[Bogotá]] and then studied from 1994 to 1998 at the [[University of Los Andes (Colombia)|Universidad de Los Andes]]. In 2002 he received his PhD from the [[University of Wisconsin-Madison]] with thesis ''Twisted K-Theory and Orbifold Cohomology of the Symmetric Product'' under the supervision of [[Alejandro Ádem]] and [[Yongbin  Ruan]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id = 58456}}</ref> He was a postdoc at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]] in Bonn. In 2003/04 he was an assistant professor at the University of Michigan. He taught as a professor at the [[Universidad Nacional de Colombia]] and as a full professor from 2012 to 2014 at Bogotá's Universidad de los Andes. Since 2014 has been a professor at the [[Universidad del Norte, Colombia|Universidad del Norte]] in [[Barranquilla]]. In 2008/09 he was a visiting scholar in [[Mexico City]]. In 2010 he worked with [[Wolfgang Lück]] at the University of Münster.

==Honors and awards==
In 2012 he received a [[Humboldt Research Award]], with which he was at the [[University of Bonn]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Living Between Colombia and Germany|website=Alexander von Humboldt Foundation|url=https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/1603188.html|access-date=2019-10-11|archive-date=2018-07-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180714164413/https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/web/1603188.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Uribe received the Mathematics Prize of the [[The World Academy of Sciences|Third World Academy of Sciences]] in 2012. In 2018 he was an invited speaker with talk ''The evenness conjecture in equivariant unitary bordism'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Rio de Janeiro. From July 2017 to June 2019 he was President of the [[Colombian Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Bernardo Uribe Jongbloed|website=sites.google.com|url=https://sites.google.com/site/bernardouribejongbloed/|access-date=2024-07-11}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*with [[Ernesto Lupercio]]: Gerbes over orbifolds and twisted K-theory, [[Communications in Mathematical Physics]], vol. 245, 2004, pp. 449–489 {{doi|10.1007/s00220-003-1035-x}}
*with Ernesto Lupercio: Loop groupoids, gerbes, and twisted sectors on orbifolds, 2001, [https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0110207 Arxiv]
*Orbifold cohomology of the symmetric product, 2001, [https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0109125 Arxiv]
*with Lupercio: An introduction to Gerbes on Orbifolds, Annales Mathématiques Blaise Pascal, [https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0402318 Arxiv 2004]
